can_do_statement: Can use 'the' with a limited range of superlative adjectives without a following noun, when the meaning is clear from the context.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: the + superlative alone — name the top member without listing the noun
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker picks the top member alone when context supplies the rest

positives: It's the biggest and oldest museum in the country.
Of all the dishes, this was the best.
negatives: It's the biggest room in the house.
I always try to do my best.

can_do_statement: Can form an increasing range of complex noun phrases with a superlative adjective + prepositional phrase.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: superlative + noun + of/in/for — identify the one unique member across contexts
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker highlights the unique member against a wider context

positives: It is the most expensive dress in the shop.
She was the youngest member of the team.
negatives: It's just the best.
The room was the biggest.

can_do_statement: Can form superlative adjective phrases using 'the most', with longer adjectives of two or more syllables.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: the most + adjective — stamp a multi-syllable adjective as rank-one
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker grades two-plus-syllable adjectives to the top

positives: That was the most delicious meal I have ever eaten.
This is the most interesting book in the library.
negatives: Most people like chocolate.
I am most grateful for your help.

guideword: FORM/USE: 'THE BEST' WITH NOUN AND PRESENT PERFECT
can_do_statement: Can use 'the best' before a noun + present perfect to talk about a unique experience.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: the best + noun + have ever + past participle — name a unique experience up to speech time
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker locates the unique experience at the open-ended present

positives: It's the best meal I have ever eaten.
That was the best trip we have ever taken.
negatives: It was the best meal yesterday.
The best thing about her is her honesty.

guideword: FORM: 'THE BEST' WITH NOUN AND 'TO-' INFINITIVE
can_do_statement: Can use 'the best' before a noun + 'to'-infinitive.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: the best + noun + to + verb — name the top context for an action
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker positions an action as the top-of-its-kind purpose

positives: It's the best time to visit the city.
That's the best way to learn English.
negatives: It's the best meal in the city.
That was the best movie we saw.

can_do_statement: Can use a postmodifier to make the superlative stronger in the structure superlative + postmodifier.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: the + superlative + noun + that/who/which/I/you/we — annotate the top member with a clause
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker appends a clause to sharpen the superlative target

positives: It was the worst decision that the committee made all year.
She's the brightest student who has ever attended this school.
negatives: It was the biggest room.
She was the youngest member.

can_do_statement: Can use the premodifer 'by far' to make a superlative adjective stronger.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: by far + the + superlative — push the top rank past the runner-up
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker leaves no doubt about the top rank

positives: It's by far the best restaurant in town.
She is by far the most experienced teacher here.
negatives: It's the best restaurant in town.
She is the most experienced teacher.

can_do_statement: Can use '(one of) the' with an increasing range of superlative adjectives without a following noun.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: one of the + superlative — name a single elite member of a tier
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker flags one member of the top tier

positives: It's one of the best restaurants in the area.
She's one of the most talented singers in the country.
negatives: It's the best restaurant in town.
She is the most talented singer.

can_do_statement: Can use superlative adjectives before a noun + 'to'-infinitive.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: superlative + noun + to + verb — anchor an action in the top rank of contexts
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker positions an action at the top of its purpose

positives: It's the most expensive place to stay in town.
That's the cheapest way to travel abroad.
negatives: It's the best restaurant in town.
That's the cheapest meal.

can_do_statement: Can use 'one of the' before a superlative adjective, followed by a plural noun.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: one of the + superlative + plural noun — pick one elite member of a tier
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker selects a single top-tier member

positives: It's one of the best restaurants in town.
She's one of the most famous singers in the country.
negatives: It's the best restaurant.
She is the most famous singer.

can_do_statement: Can form noun phrases with a range of determiners before a superlative adjective.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: determiner + superlative + noun — slot any determiner before the rank
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker frames the top rank against any context

positives: I bought these clothes for my youngest brother.
Please wear your oldest clothes.
negatives: I went home and rested.
She finished her homework.

can_do_statement: Can use 'the slightest', 'the faintest' with a specific range of nouns to express the least amount.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: the slightest / the faintest + noun — name the tiniest margin of a thing

positives: I don't have the slightest idea what you mean.
There wasn't the faintest trace of evidence.
negatives: I have a slight idea.
There is a faint trace of light.

can_do_statement: Can use a postmodifier to make the superlative stronger, in the structure superlative + noun + postmodifier.

ontology.pedagogical_hook: superlative + noun + that/which/who — annotate the top-tier entity with a follow-up clause
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker embeds a relative clause to sharpen the superlative entity

positives: It's the best Italian restaurant I have ever eaten at.
That was the most expensive car the family owned.
negatives: It's the best restaurant.
It was the most expensive car.
